Function: Shows detailed startup, shutdown, sign-in, and sign-out progress.
Reason: Useful troubleshooting option in Explorer; another policy can suppress these messages.

Function: Chooses which ELAM-classified boot drivers may load.
Reason: Boot compatibility and recovery consequences; expose only with a dedicated security workflow.

Function: Sets a bundle of old Internet Communication restrictions.
Reason: Too broad for one control; inspect supported child policies. Shared addresses do not prove the bundle is configured.

Policy: Specify a custom active power plan
Function: Forces one active power plan by its GUID.
Reason: Use existing Power control; reconcile policy ownership and available plans.

Function: Disables Windows power throttling.
Reason: Useful Power choice; explain energy and background-performance tradeoffs without promising higher performance.

Function: Requires Fast Startup and its hibernation prerequisite.
Reason: Fold into Power. Disabling this policy returns control to the local preference; it does not force Fast Startup off.

Policy: Allow Secure Boot for integrity validation
Function: Chooses Secure Boot rather than legacy integrity validation for BitLocker.
Reason: Keep with BitLocker; firmware changes can trigger recovery when legacy validation is selected.

Function: Sets permitted or required BitLocker startup PIN, USB key, and TPM combinations.
Reason: Needs validation, protector management, and recovery planning; setting policy alone does not configure an existing protector.

Function: Suppresses contextual Windows tips.
Reason: Connect policy to the existing tips control; installed help restricts this policy to Enterprise and Education.

Policy: Turn off cloud consumer account state content
Function: Replaces cloud consumer-account content with fallback content.
Reason: Add a distinct policy option inside suggestions; consumer-experiences policy is not an equivalent.

Function: Replaces cloud-optimized Windows content with fallback content.
Reason: Keep separate from consumer-account content within suggestions.

Function: Suppresses Microsoft consumer recommendations and account notifications.
Reason: Existing route; verify supported editions, saved policy, and effective state.

Function: Caps Windows diagnostic-data collection and users' ability to increase it.
Reason: Expose supported levels; off requires Enterprise, Education, or Server. Does not govern all third-party applications.

Function: Selects Delivery Optimization HTTP and peer download modes.
Reason: Expand the existing update control; exclude Windows 11 deprecated bypass mode.

Policy: Allow antimalware service to remain running always
Function: Keeps the antimalware service running when both security-intelligence families are disabled.
Reason: An internal service-lifecycle detail, not a useful desktop protection choice.

Policy: Allow antimalware service to startup with normal priority
Function: Chooses normal or low startup priority for the antimalware service.
Reason: Specialist performance tuning; retain defaults until measured evidence justifies a control.

Policy: Configure detection for potentially unwanted applications
Function: Blocks, audits, or allows potentially unwanted applications.
Reason: Useful Security control with explicit modes and observed Defender state.

Function: Historically disabled Defender Antivirus using DisableAntiSpyware.
Reason: Do not add an unreliable legacy off switch; modern platform and tamper protection can ignore it.

Function: Enables Defender cloud protection and submission of threat metadata to MAPS.
Reason: Useful privacy and security choice; old Basic and Advanced values both mean Advanced on Windows 10 onward.

Policy: Configure monitoring for incoming and outgoing file and program activity
Function: Limits NTFS real-time file monitoring to incoming, outgoing, or both directions.
Reason: Server-oriented workload tuning; do not imply that it controls firewall traffic.

Policy: Monitor file and program activity on your computer
Function: Enables monitoring of file and program activity.
Reason: Place under detailed Defender protection settings; verify tamper-protection refusal.

Policy: Scan all downloaded files and attachments
Function: Enables scanning of downloaded files and attachments.
Reason: Separate protection component; a dependency of Block at First Sight.

Function: Controls Defender real-time scanning and monitoring.
Reason: Useful Security state/control through a supported mechanism; show blocked changes honestly, never infer success from a policy write.

Function: Detects threats through program behavior.
Reason: Detailed Defender option, not a general performance tweak.

Function: Scans scripts for threats.
Reason: Detailed Defender option; unrelated to allowing PowerShell execution.

Policy: Configure time interval for service health reports
Function: Sets the interval for Defender service-health reports.
Reason: Fleet reporting infrastructure; little practical value as a personal-PC control.

Policy: Configure time out for detections in critically failed state
Function: Sets when critically failed detection records change state.
Reason: Detection-report lifecycle, not a malware scan or quarantine setting.

Policy: Configure time out for detections in non-critical failed state
Function: Sets when noncritical failed detection records clear.
Reason: Detection-report lifecycle; omit from ordinary controls.

Policy: Configure time out for detections in recently remediated state
Function: Sets when completed detection records clear.
Reason: Report-state timing, not a general protection-history retention control.

Policy: Configure time out for detections requiring additional action
Function: Sets when additional-action detection records clear.
Reason: Reporting bookkeeping; omit from ordinary controls.

Function: Controls Defender Watson event reporting.
Reason: Potential diagnostics/privacy option, but needs current platform support and data-flow verification.

Policy: Configure whether to report Dynamic Signature dropped events
Function: Reports dropped dynamic-signature events.
Reason: Specialist troubleshooting telemetry; not an ordinary privacy master switch.

Policy: Configure Windows software trace preprocessor components
Function: Selects Defender WPP trace components.
Reason: Developer troubleshooting configuration.

Function: Selects Defender WPP trace verbosity.
Reason: Developer troubleshooting configuration.

Function: Suppresses Defender enhanced notifications.
Reason: Integrate with one Security notification control; distinguish Defender messages from Windows Security messages.

Policy: Check for the latest virus and spyware security intelligence before running a scheduled scan
Function: Checks security intelligence before scheduled scans.
Reason: Useful within a future Defender schedule editor; does not affect manually started scans.

Function: Scans network files when accessed.
Reason: Keep separate from scheduled mapped-drive scanning and network-domain protection.

Function: Enables heuristic detection of unfamiliar threats.
Reason: Detailed protection setting; do not present disabling it as an optimization.

Policy: Allow real-time security intelligence updates based on reports to Microsoft MAPS
Function: Receives rapid threat-specific intelligence after MAPS reports.
Reason: Cloud-protection dependency; not the normal update schedule.

Policy: Allow security intelligence updates from Microsoft Update
Function: Permits Microsoft Update as an intelligence source despite another configured source.
Reason: Mainly managed-update environments; later source-selection editor.

Policy: Use a common set of exploit protection settings
Function: Imports system and application exploit mitigations from an XML location.
Reason: Requires trusted-file validation and capture of actual mitigation state, not merely the file path.

Function: Chooses startup pages for legacy Microsoft Edge.
Reason: Use current Chromium Edge startup policies if this feature is added; do not add the old EdgeHTML policy.

Function: Allows Windows Search to search cloud content such as OneDrive and SharePoint.
Reason: Distinct from web results; belongs in Search with applicable account/build checks.

Function: Allowed the retired Cortana assistant while retaining local search.
Reason: No new Cortana switch for the Windows 11 target.

Function: Allowed speech interaction with Cortana while locked.
Reason: Retired assistant; not a modern voice-access or Copilot setting.

Policy: Allow search and Cortana to use location
Function: Allows location-aware Search and Cortana results.
Reason: Mixed current/retired feature identity; prove a current Search effect before offering it.

Function: Removes web search from an older Windows Desktop Search implementation.
Reason: Installed support reference is RedistOnly; do not equate this with a working modern Search policy.

Policy: Don't search the web or display web results in Search
Function: Suppresses connected web queries and results in Search.
Reason: Resolve supported Windows 11 behavior before merging with the existing Bing preference control.

Policy: Don't search the web or display web results in Search over metered connections
Function: Suppresses connected Search web results only on metered connections.
Reason: Installed support is Windows 8.1 exclusive; no new Windows 11 control.

Policy: Set what information is shared in Search
Function: Chooses personal data shared with Bing by connected Search.
Reason: Installed support is Windows 8.1 exclusive; not a current diagnostic-data switch.

Function: Starts deployment of Secure Boot certificates into firmware.
Reason: A dedicated maintenance action, not a reversible toggle; certificates cannot be undone from Windows.

Function: Allows or blocks the Widgets experience.
Reason: Add policy semantics beside taskbar visibility; hiding the button is a different state.

Function: Blocks Widgets Board invocation and its taskbar entry point.
Reason: Expose separately where supported; the current CSP page labels it Insider Preview.

Function: Suppresses Widgets on the lock screen.
Reason: Useful distinct option; gate by confirmed build support rather than this preview host alone.

Policy: Allow export of Recall and snapshot information
Function: Permits user-initiated encrypted Recall snapshot export.
Reason: EEA-only feature with edition/build documentation differences; not a Recall disable switch.

Function: Controls Recall component availability; disabling removes it and saved snapshots.
Reason: Audit existing control first. Restoring a registry value cannot restore deleted snapshots.

Function: Disables the AI agent experience in Settings search.
Reason: Useful AI choice; ordinary indexed and semantic search remain. Gate edition/build because current CSP lists preview support.

Policy: Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall
Function: Forbids future Recall snapshots and deletes existing snapshots.
Reason: Existing control needs accurate destructive-effect handling and per-user consent semantics.

Policy: Enables or disables Windows Game Recording and Broadcasting
Function: Permits or prohibits Windows game recording and broadcasting.
Reason: Extend the existing capture preference control with machine policy and effective-state detection.

Function: A Windows Media Player policy named Prevent Automatic Updates has help describing first-run dialogs.
Reason: Both installed help and Microsoft documentation conflict with the name. Do not classify it as Windows Update or implement guessed behavior.

Function: Historically installed updates immediately when they required no restart.
Reason: Microsoft confirms no effect on Windows 10 or 11.

Policy: Enabling Windows Update Power Management to automatically wake up the system to install scheduled updates
Function: Permits Windows Update to wake sleeping PCs for scheduled installation.
Reason: Useful intent, but installed support excludes Windows 11; verify a supported replacement before promising control.

Policy: Turn on recommended updates via Automatic Updates
Function: Historically included recommended updates with important updates.
Reason: Microsoft confirms no effect on Windows 10 or 11.

Function: Controls automatic download/install behavior and scheduled installation.
Reason: Expose NoAutoUpdate and valid client scheduling fields atomically; exclude obsolete and Server-only modes.

Policy: Specify deadline for automatic updates and restarts for feature update
Function: Sets feature-update installation deadlines and restart grace periods.
Reason: Use a shared update schedule editor; deadlines override normal scheduling after expiry on patched Windows 11.

Policy: Specify deadline for automatic updates and restarts for quality update
Function: Sets quality-update installation deadlines and restart grace periods.
Reason: Keep separate values from feature updates inside the same editor; explain forced restarts after expiry.

Policy: Turn off auto-restart for updates during active hours
Function: Prevents update restarts within policy-defined active hours, subject to stronger restart policies.
Reason: Integrate with the active-hours control; include deadline conflicts and supported hour ranges.

Policy: Update Power Policy for Cart Restarts
Function: Skips power checks for scheduled restarts of school devices stored on carts.
Reason: Education fleet workflow, not a general laptop wake or restart control.

Function: Bypasses compatibility safeguard holds on feature upgrades.
Reason: Useful for deliberate testing only; it does not improve compatibility or repair the underlying issue.

Policy: Do not include drivers with Windows Updates
Function: Excludes Driver-classified updates from Windows quality updates.
Reason: Keep existing control; do not describe it as blocking every driver installation source.

Function: Hides selected Windows Settings pages or permits only selected pages.
Reason: Useful customization/Owner option later; needs a named-page picker and a reliable restore path.

Function: Prevents invoking a camera from the lock screen.
Reason: Verify the feature exists on the target build; not a camera privacy master switch or Windows Hello control.

Policy: Allow users to enable online speech recognition services
Function: Prevents users from enabling online speech recognition.
Reason: Join policy with existing speech preference; allowing it does not opt the user into speech services.

Function: Disables the pre-Vista Active Desktop feature.
Reason: Obsolete target and wrong exported scope; not a Windows 11 desktop setting.

Function: Removes old Active Desktop web content.
Reason: Not ordinary desktop icons; obsolete target and wrong exported scope.

Function: Forces the pre-Vista Active Desktop feature on.
Reason: Obsolete target and wrong exported scope.

Function: Prevents adding web content to Active Desktop.
Reason: Obsolete target and wrong exported scope.

Function: Locks the old Active Desktop configuration.
Reason: Obsolete target and wrong exported scope.

Policy: Prohibit use of Internet Connection Firewall on your DNS domain network
Function: Prohibits the pre-XP-SP2 Internet Connection Firewall on a matching DNS domain.
Reason: Not Windows Defender Firewall; exclude the obsolete policy.

Policy: Remove Recommended section from Start Menu
Function: Removes the Start menu Recommended section.
Reason: Existing route; verify edition/build and distinguish hiding content from removing the section.

Policy: Do not allow Windows to activate Enhanced Storage devices
Function: Prevents activation of Enhanced Storage devices.
Reason: Specialized storage hardware workflow; not ordinary removable-drive access or BitLocker.

Policy: Configures LSASS to run as a protected process
Function: Runs LSASS as a protected process, optionally with a UEFI lock.
Reason: Useful hardening, but start with status and reversible mode; locked mode requires a separate recovery-aware workflow.

Function: Allows or prohibits clipboard history.
Reason: Useful privacy control; separate allowed state from the user's enabled preference.

Function: Allows or prohibits clipboard sync across the same account's devices.
Reason: Use the existing clipboard-sync feature; permitting sync does not establish user opt-in.

Function: Allows applications to publish User Activities.
Reason: Audit the existing activity control against current Windows behavior; distinct from Recall and diagnostics.

Function: Historically allowed published User Activities to upload to Microsoft.
Reason: Cloud activity-history sending was removed from patched Windows 11 in January 2024; do not add a current upload switch.

Function: Enabled the Activity Feed, including historical cross-device activity synchronization.
Reason: Timeline and cloud synchronization retired on Windows 11; prove any remaining local consumer before extending the existing control.

Policy: Configure the level of TPM owner authorization information available to the operating system
Function: Selects how much TPM owner-authorization material Windows stores locally.
Reason: Modern default 5 is absent from the old template choices. Retaining the full password requires value 4 before provisioning; verify other modes.

Function: Stops compatibility inventory of applications, files, devices, and drivers being sent to Microsoft.
Reason: Useful privacy option; dependency on CEIP means the control may already be covered by another setting.

Function: Disables the manually used Steps Recorder support tool.
Reason: Deprecated feature, not continuous background recording. Retain recognition if present rather than prioritizing an editor.

Policy: Notify antivirus programs when opening attachments
Function: Asks registered antivirus products to scan opened attachments and blocks opening if the scanner fails.
Reason: User policy, despite machine scope in export; distinguish this extra callback from normal on-access scanning.

Policy: Do not suggest third-party content in Windows spotlight
Function: Removes third-party suggestions from Windows Spotlight experiences.
Reason: Wire the existing read-only definition into suggestions; use the actual user scope.

Function: Controls cloud registration of the device's location for Find My Device.
Reason: Useful privacy/recovery tradeoff; account and location prerequisites must be shown.

Function: Prohibits programs from using the Windows location feature.
Reason: Extend the location control with machine policy; does not stop all possible network-based location inference.

Function: Allows cloud backup and restore of cellular text messages.
Reason: Not general messaging or Phone Link sync; confirm a current cellular-message consumer before adding it.

Policy: Configure local administrator merge behavior for lists
Function: Decides whether locally configured Defender lists merge with Group Policy lists.
Reason: Belongs with exclusions and policy-source ownership; can change which exclusions actually apply.

Function: Randomizes scheduled Defender scan and intelligence-update times.
Reason: Useful within a schedule editor; display the configured window, not only a boolean.

Function: Selects automatic threat remediation versus asking the user to choose an action.
Reason: Explicit Security behavior; not the same as turning scanning off.

Function: Suppresses antimalware reboot notifications in a specific UI mode.
Reason: Verify modern applicability; do not merge silently with hiding informational notifications.

Function: Disables automatic exclusions for Windows Server roles.
Reason: Server-only policy outside the current Windows client target.

Policy: Configure local setting override for reporting to Microsoft MAPS
Function: Lets the local MAPS preference override its Group Policy setting.
Reason: Policy-source precedence detail; belongs under cloud protection ownership, not a separate feature switch.

Policy: Configure the 'Block at First Sight' feature
Function: Checks suspicious content with Defender cloud protection before allowing it.
Reason: Expose with cloud protection and dependency checks for samples, downloaded-file scans, and real-time protection.

Policy: Send file samples when further analysis is required
Function: Chooses prompting, safe samples, all samples, or no automatic sample submission.
Reason: Useful privacy/security choice; explain effects on cloud protection rather than hiding it in a telemetry preset.

Function: Blocks or audits untrusted changes to protected folders or disk sectors.
Reason: Ransomware protection needs mode selection, allowed apps, and protected-folder management.

Policy: Prevent users and apps from accessing dangerous websites
Function: Blocks or audits applications connecting to malicious domains.
Reason: Distinct from firewall rules and browser SmartScreen; verify prerequisites and observed protection mode.

Function: Adds waiting time for Defender to obtain a cloud verdict on a suspicious file.
Reason: Dependency-aware cloud-protection tuning; display total timeout, not just the added seconds.

Function: Computes hashes for files Defender scans.
Reason: Mostly investigative/reporting value; verify the current platform and cost before exposing it.

Function: Selects how aggressively Defender cloud protection blocks suspicious or unknown files.
Reason: Useful advanced mode selector; explain false positives and cloud-service dependency.

Function: Retires network-inspection signatures for vulnerabilities already patched.
Reason: Engine-maintenance detail; do not confuse it with definition updates or malicious-domain protection.

Policy: Configure local setting override for monitoring file and program activity on your computer
Function: Lets local file/program monitoring preferences override policy.
Reason: Integrate into source handling for row 21 rather than a duplicate card.

Policy: Configure local setting override for monitoring for incoming and outgoing file activity
Function: Lets local incoming/outgoing scan preferences override policy.
Reason: Integrate into source handling for row 20 rather than a duplicate card.

Policy: Configure local setting override for scanning all downloaded files and attachments
Function: Lets local downloaded-file scanning preferences override policy.
Reason: Integrate into source handling for row 22 rather than a duplicate card.

Policy: Configure local setting override for turn on behavior monitoring
Function: Lets local behavior-monitoring preferences override policy.
Reason: Integrate into source handling for row 24 rather than a duplicate card.

Policy: Configure local setting override to turn on real-time protection
Function: Lets local real-time protection preferences override policy.
Reason: Integrate into source handling for row 23; tamper protection is an additional constraint.

Policy: Define the maximum size of downloaded files and attachments to be scanned
Function: Limits the size of downloaded files and attachments eligible for scanning.
Reason: Specialist scan tuning; requires current units, limits, and protection-impact validation.

Policy: Turn on process scanning whenever real-time protection is enabled
Function: Scans running processes when real-time protection is enabled again.
Reason: Detailed protection option; useful only alongside the real-time control.

Policy: Turn on raw volume write notifications
Function: Passes raw disk-write notifications to behavior monitoring.
Reason: Low-level engine plumbing; no clear ordinary-user workflow.

Policy: Configure low CPU priority for scheduled scans
Function: Uses low CPU priority for scheduled Defender scans.
Reason: Useful performance choice; does not cap CPU usage or change manually started scans.

Function: Requests a daily restore point before Defender cleaning.
Reason: Not a general restore-point schedule; verify System Protection support and actual creation.

Function: Scans archive contents during applicable scans.
Reason: Detailed scan option; directed scans still scan archives according to installed help.

Function: Runs a missed scheduled full scan after repeated missed scans.
Reason: Place in a Defender schedule editor; not a schedule by itself.

Function: Runs a missed scheduled quick scan after repeated missed scans.
Reason: Place beside full-scan catch-up and explain the schedule dependency.

Function: Parses legacy mailbox file formats for malware.
Reason: Installed help excludes modern email clients; do not market this as current email protection.

Function: Follows reparse points during scanning.
Reason: Specialist coverage/performance tradeoff with recursion concerns; default remains off.

Policy: Allow notifications to disable security intelligence based reports to Microsoft MAPS
Function: Receives MAPS instructions disabling individual signatures causing false positives.
Reason: Part of cloud-intelligence behavior, not notifications shown to the user.

Policy: Allow security intelligence updates when running on battery power
Function: Permits security-intelligence updates while on battery.
Reason: Useful battery option within Defender update settings, not Windows Update settings.

Policy: Check for the latest virus and spyware security intelligence on startup
Function: Checks for security-intelligence updates when the antimalware service starts.
Reason: Combine with Defender update scheduling.

Policy: Define the number of days after which a catch-up security intelligence update is required
Function: Sets how old intelligence may become before a catch-up update is required.
Reason: Expose with schedule and update-source dependencies.

Policy: Initiate security intelligence update on startup
Function: Initiates updates at startup when no antimalware engine is present.
Reason: Bootstrap/recovery detail; not the ordinary startup-update control in row 127.

Policy: Specify the time to check for security intelligence updates
Function: Sets the local time for checking security-intelligence updates.
Reason: Time picker in the Defender schedule editor; preserve randomization and source settings.

Policy: Turn on scan after security intelligence update
Function: Triggers a scan after security-intelligence updates.
Reason: Place with Defender schedules; current platform semantics need verification.

Function: Removes Paint Cocreator functionality.
Reason: Useful individual AI option; check Paint version, hardware, and supported Windows build.

Function: Removes Paint generative fill functionality.
Reason: Keep separately selectable within Paint AI controls; do not disable ordinary editing.

Function: Removes Paint Image Creator functionality.
Reason: Keep separately selectable within Paint AI controls.

Function: Controls Search highlights in Start search and Search home.
Reason: Connect the machine policy to the existing preference control and show effective state.

Policy: Allow Automatic Update of Speech Data
Function: Permits downloads of updated speech recognition and synthesis models.
Reason: Controls model updates, not microphone access or online recognition; disabling can leave older language models.

Function: Targets the old integrated Windows Copilot experience, in an unsupported machine scope.
Reason: Correct existing detection and replace the claimed effect with current app management, not another legacy toggle.

Function: Warns about entering a protected sign-in password into a malicious site or app.
Reason: Group under phishing protection; verify sign-in method and base protection prerequisites.

Function: Warns when a protected sign-in password is reused elsewhere.
Reason: Separate choice beside malicious-site warnings; not a general password-manager audit.

Function: Chooses app-source recommendations, warnings, or Store-only installation.
Reason: Useful Security choice; present all modes and dependency on SmartScreen.

Function: Controls reputation warnings for downloaded applications, with optional prevention of bypass.
Reason: One SmartScreen control with modes; not Edge-only SmartScreen or Smart App Control.

Policy: Prevent Windows Media DRM Internet Access
Function: Blocks legacy Windows Media DRM license acquisition and security updates.
Reason: Can break protected-media playback; no evidence that it controls current DRM systems.

Function: Prevents local users editing exploit protection in Windows Security.
Reason: An ownership restriction, not protection itself; belongs with exploit-protection management.

Function: Hides all Windows Security notifications, including important alerts.
Reason: Optional advanced notification mode; never label it as only removing nags.

Function: Hides noncritical Windows Security notifications while keeping critical alerts.
Reason: Useful notification choice; all-notifications policy overrides it.

Policy: Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences
Function: Prevents diagnostic data being used to personalize Windows suggestions.
Reason: Connect user policy to the existing control; it does not stop collection or remove every suggestion.

Policy: Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall
Function: Applies the Recall snapshot restriction in user scope and deletes that user's existing snapshots.
Reason: Unify with row 58 while preserving scope and destructive-effect handling.

Function: Targets the legacy integrated Windows Copilot in its valid user scope.
Reason: Do not claim this disables the current Copilot app; replace with supported app management.
